headline: I build Android apps that make it to the real world.
intro: Android developer specializing in Kotlin, Jetpack Compose and modern app architecture. I build thoughtful mobile experiences, reliable data pipelines and the backends that power them.
about: I'm a 2026 Computer Science and Engineering graduate from Vellore Institute of Technology, focused on building production-minded Android applications. I independently built and published PaisaPulse Ledger on Google Play, from Compose UI and Room persistence to background SMS processing and a deployed FastAPI backend. I also have experience with Java Spring Boot APIs and Flutter development, including an internship at My3 Digital.
lifequestDescription: Currently building a gamified self-improvement app with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. Daily quests, XP, levels, streaks and progress tracking are planned, with a Java Spring Boot backend to come. Not yet released on Google Play.
